name: Activate the MITC Vision exhibition
description: Verifies the exhibition activates with MITC branding and the digital host.
steps: Wait for the opening sequence to complete
expected: The activation screen disappears and the MITC Vision exhibition opens with the 2026 convocation and ICT department identity. The SEE LIVE CODING control is available only in autonomous mode and opens the coding workspace only after an explicit click; HTML, CSS and JavaScript can be edited and run to update the sandboxed preview.

name: Present Software Engineering as a distinct course choice
description: Verifies Software Engineering is pitched as its own selectable course with realistic career directions.
steps: Listen through the Software Engineering sections
expected: Software Engineering is presented as a separate course, covering .NET/C#, ASP.NET Core, APIs, databases, system design, testing and deployment basics, plus possible career directions without promising employment.

name: Present Web Design as a separate course choice
description: Verifies Web Design is not described as compulsory alongside Software Engineering.
steps: Listen through the Web Design section
expected: Web Design is presented as a separate selectable course covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, responsive design and WordPress.

name: Welcome visitors without unreliable guest counting
covers: camera presence detection with motion cue
description: Verifies the sensor welcomes visitors and the speech sequence does not overlap.
steps: Activate the exhibition with camera access available
Stand in the camera view during autonomous mode
Listen to the greeting and course introduction
Leave the camera view until presence clears
expected: When a person is detected, the host says 'I see you' and completes the welcome before beginning the department introduction. After the full introduction finishes, the presence sensor automatically re-arms and repeats the greeting and introduction if the visitor remains in view; if no visitor is detected, it stays in autonomous scanning mode. It never overlaps an ongoing introduction or shows a guest total.

name: Remain usable without camera access
description: Verifies the exhibition remains usable if camera access is denied.
steps: Open the application without granting camera access
expected: The exhibition remains visible and provides informational content without relying on visitor detection.
